guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Join the Ritual Discord
guide.description: Go to Ritual’s Discord and complete onboarding. You’ll need a verified Discord account. The Discord is where roles are assigned and where testnet access is gated.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete Community Quests
guide.description: Visit the Ritual quest portal and log in with your Discord account. Complete available tasks to earn XP and role upgrades. Current quest categories include: Social tasks Discord engagement and invites Pledge section submissions (if open — submit unique text when active)
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Earn and Upgrade Discord Roles
guide.description: You can move up in your role by being active on Discord. The team keeps track of roles like Ritualist, Zealot, Summoner, Radiant Ritualist, and Pledged to Synful. Higher roles give you priority access to the testnet. Keep an eye on channels and announcements for tasks that are specific to your role.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

faq.q: 积分一定会兑换 Token 吗？
faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
